$comment: Dynamic lights (docs/LIGHTS.md §3, ARCHITECTURE.md §6.1): the smooth point lights of light sources (the blocks' `light`, shared/blocks), held in a hand (yours and other players') and, with Torch shadows on, placed. maxLights: the most drawn a frame, the nearest to the eye first (the shader holds up to 16). cullM: a light farther than this from the eye is left out. nearM: the falloff's softening distance (m): the light at distance d is strength × (1 + nearM²) / (d² + nearM²) × (1 − (d / radius)⁴)², so it is the source's strength at 1 m, ends smoothly at its radius and stays finite at the flame. charactersNearM: the softening on characters (at least this): a torch held beside a body lights its hand without burning it out. Run `node shared/look/lights.mjs` after editing; CI fails if crates/dwell-look/src/lights.gen.rs is stale.
